tools.name: getUIComponents
tools.description: Provides the complete raw catalog of all Magic UI components without implementation code or examples. For discovery, use getComponentIndex (categorized overview) or searchComponents (keyword/category filtering). To fetch full implementation details, use getComponentDetails for a single component, getComponentsByNames for a selected set of known components, or category-specific tools for bulk retrieval.

tools.name: getComponentIndex
tools.description: Provides a full categorized index of Magic UI components with example coverage counts to help clients discover components by category. Use searchComponents for keyword/category-filtered queries. Once you identify components, call getComponentDetails for a single component, getComponentsByNames for a hand-picked list of known components, or use category-specific tools to fetch multiple components at once.

tools.name: getComponentDetails
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive implementation details for a single Magic UI component by name, including full source code, installation instructions, and all associated examples. Use this when you already know one component name (e.g., from searchComponents or getComponentIndex results) and need its complete implementation. If you already know several component names, use getComponentsByNames instead.

componentName.description: The exact name of the component to retrieve (e.g., 'marquee', 'animated-beam', 'shimmer-button').

tools.name: getComponentsByNames
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive implementation details for multiple known Magic UI components in a single request, including full source code, installation instructions, and associated examples for each found component. Use this after getComponentIndex or searchComponents when you already know a specific set of component names and want a targeted batch fetch without pulling an entire category.

componentNames.description: An array of exact component names to retrieve (e.g., ['marquee', 'animated-beam', 'shimmer-button']).

tools.name: searchComponents
tools.description: Searches Magic UI components by keyword (matched against name and description) with an optional category filter. Returns matching components with their category assignments and example counts. After finding relevant components, use getComponentDetails to fetch a single component's full implementation, getComponentsByNames to fetch several selected matches at once, or call the appropriate category tool to retrieve multiple components at once.

query.description: Keyword to search for in component names and descriptions.

category.description: Optional category name to restrict the search (e.g. 'Buttons', 'TextAnimations'). Must match a key in the component categories.

tools.name: getComponents
tools.description: Provides detailed implementation data for marquee, terminal, hero-video-dialog, bento-grid, animated-list, dock, globe, tweet-card, client-tweet-card, orbiting-circles, avatar-circles, icon-cloud, animated-circular-progress-bar, file-tree, code-comparison, script-copy-btn, scroll-progress, lens, pointer components in the Components category. Use getComponentIndex first if you need a categorized discovery overview before fetching full component code and examples. If you only need a selected subset of known components, use getComponentsByNames instead.
